{"script":"set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p temp_checks
# Create recursive listing of /working
if [ -d /working ]; then
  find /working -print > temp_checks/initial_listing.txt
else
  : > temp_checks/initial_listing.txt
fi
# Extract entries whose final component is exactly "workspace"
awk -F'/' '$NF=="workspace" {print}' temp_checks/initial_listing.txt > temp_checks/matches_raw.txt
# Determine type for each path
: > temp_checks/matches_checked.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -f "$p" ]; then
    echo "$p:regular file" >> temp_checks/matches_checked.txt
  elif [ -d "$p" ]; then
    echo "$p:directory" >> temp_checks/matches_checked.txt
  elif [ -L "$p" ]; then
    echo "$p:symlink" >> temp_checks/matches_checked.txt
  else
    echo "$p:other" >> temp_checks/matches_checked.txt
  fi
done < temp_checks/matches_raw.txt
# Normalize paths and remove duplicates, keep type
(while IFS= read -r line; do
  path="${line%%:*}"
  type="${line#*:}"
  if norm=$(realpath -m "$path" 2>/dev/null); then
    :
  elif norm=$(readlink -f "$path" 2>/dev/null); then
    :
  else
    norm="$path"
  fi
  printf '%s:%s\n' "$norm" "$type"
done < temp_checks/matches_checked.txt) | sort -u > temp_checks/matches_normalized.txt
# Inspect normalized list and set flag if any regular file
if grep -q ':regular file$' temp_checks/matches_normalized.txt; then
  echo "true" > temp_checks/found_regular_file.flag
else
  echo "false" > temp_checks/found_regular_file.flag
fi
# Produce summary referencing the flag and normalized matches
{
  echo "Found regular file flag: $(cat temp_checks/found_regular_file.flag)"
  echo
  echo "Normalized matches (path:type):"
  if [ -s temp_checks/matches_normalized.txt ]; then
    sed 's/^/ - /' temp_checks/matches_normalized.txt
  else
    echo " - (none)"
  fi
} > temp_checks/summary.txt
# Final single-word output
if grep -q '^true$' temp_checks/found_regular_file.flag; then
  echo "yes"
else
  echo "no"
fi
"}
